brief: Director chooses cool for recurrent state and warm for mixture/sampling, separated by white; all outer frames and headings stay white. Use black Arial, fine dark arrows and modest consistent corners. This is an actual MDN-RNN mechanism: LSTM below MDN as in the author SVG. Updated state branches to the head and also passes directly to the output, distinct from the predicted distribution. A mathematical brace groups distribution/state, never an arithmetic node. Only the distribution enters the τ sampler; the lower hidden-state channel bypasses it. Two straight exterior arrows; no exterior loop, staircase, extra ports, title bands, gradients or decorative scenery. Use small schematic Gaussian curves with π/μ/σ, no empirical axes/values. Follow the exact inner constructions and positions in the drawing-correspondence table. All content inside parent frames with 24px padding. Render only the approved inventories; leave connector corridors blank.

topology_review: Single-cell recurrent update from current zₜ, aₜ and hₜ produces hₜ₊₁. The MDN head depends on the updated recurrent state and emits Gaussian-mixture weights, means and standard deviations, denoted π/μ/σ, describing P(zₜ₊₁ | aₜ,zₜ,hₜ). Updated state also continues as a separate state output. A semantic distribution/state tuple, not an arithmetic merge, carries both across the single exterior dynamics output. In prediction, only the distribution reaches the τ-controlled sampler; hₜ₊₁ follows the separate lower passthrough. Sampled zₜ₊₁ and updated hₜ₊₁ remain distinct terminal objects. The one-cell recurrence is made explicit by hₜ₊₁ = LSTM(zₜ,aₜ,hₜ), not a false self-loop for a single time step. This reflects the author SVG's recurrent/MDN relationship without needlessly replicating multiple cells. No future sample feeds Controller C; no done/reward/Transformer/diffusion head is present.
